executed_scripts: The two original screen.py files, whose SHA256 values are recorded in the corresponding unchanged RESULT.json files.
corrected_copy: offset-half/screen-comment-corrected.py changes only the displayed mathematical comment. It was not rerun and is not the script hash named by the original result. Both original bytes and the one-line diff are retained.
